sentences.text: The loan is a home loan (term loan) for purchase of a residential house for self-occupation, not for business, and it was sanctioned on 10 February 2026.
Clause 9.3 requires a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment in full or in part.
For this case, the applicable RBI finding says pre-payment charge is not applicable, so a clause that imposes a 3% pre-payment charge is not compliant with the RBI pre-payment rules as applied here.

missing.searched: Checked the RBI pre-payment findings for the loan's rate type; the only unmatched finding is the unknown applicability item about rate_type.
